instance.note: Bass Summer illustrative instance. All numeric values are placeholders and are not frozen; only the representation boundary is delivered.

contract.name: UsableForageAvailability
contract.semantics: per population and cell: the sum of prey biomass in that cell over prey classes that are diet-eligible for the population and whose representative prey size is inside the population's gape window; all inputs are read from the single Resolved Snapshot

fixed_combine.rule: for each prey_class bound in prey_fields, add its snapshot biomass at the cell if and only if the prey_class is in the population's diet_classes and representative_size_mm is inside [size_window_mm.min, size_window_mm.max]; the aggregation shape is a contract constant and cannot be altered per instance
